Civil Engineers by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Civil Engineers have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $116,480 in Seattle, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Seattle $116,480, Austin $100,470, Chicago $100,160.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
